5 git.pp fold participants (doctor, js, cs, pl, c)
5 git.pp fold participants (doctor, js, pl present; cs, c ABSENT)
note: THE COUNTEREXAMPLE. The fold suite itself said 'FAIL ... [participants missing: cs, c]' and exited 1 -- it reported the absence correctly. gitpp-oracle then re-labelled it status:'divergence' and printed 'NEW: fold: divergence not in known-limitations.json' -> 'ORACLE: FAIL (new divergence)'. Two ports were never run. The oracle called ABSENCE a disagreement between ports, and put it in the bucket a human reads to decide which port is wrong. With cs and c built, the same suite is 29/29 green. This row is why VERDICTS.NOT_MEASURED exists and why a missing participant must never be counted as a divergence.
